### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **22** documentable anchor(s).

**25** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (literal, 55 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **21** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a63443cd71bf014db25aadc4e8a871bdb89e7574` — the merge of head `6bfc975899a1ed10282cfe967eb01ed3ad7e8ea8` into base `f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a63443cd71bf014db25aadc4e8a871bdb89e7574 && git checkout a63443cd71bf014db25aadc4e8a871bdb89e7574
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc 6bfc975899a1ed10282cfe967eb01ed3ad7e8ea8 && git checkout -B drift-repro f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc && git merge --no-ff 6bfc975899a1ed10282cfe967eb01ed3ad7e8ea8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f02f4f63707bd05ae2186ca63babd54bfe37abcc` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

**L1 first review · ACCEPT** · head `6bfc975899a1ed10282cfe967eb01ed3ad7e8ea8` (final head 6946100255) · card #34535 · read 2026-11-17T11:00Z

### Checklist (read on GitHub at this head, not from the report)

- **Shape:**
  - Draft PR against `main`; `mergeable_state` is `clean`, and the title carries `!`.
  - The only closing-keyword hit is `Fixes #34535`.
  - The footer is in AGENTS.md's PR-body form.
  - The claim (6943200727, 08:46Z) is earlier than the 09:49Z wind-down, so this PR is in flight.
- **Declarations:**
  - Body and changeset both declare `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.
  - The body adds `Skills-docs: none`. I verified it: `git grep -i import-users -- skills` returns 0 hits at this head.
  - The changeset is `patch` with `**BREAKING**`, four FROM → TO lines, and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. That marker holds, because only admin HTTP answers move: no schema key, export or stored row.
  - `patch` for a narrowing has precedent among the pending changesets (for example `33203-managed-no-local-password.md` on the same package).
- **Against ruling 6942842013 (B, plus the seat's reading on matched users):**
  - Each row joins in the unit of work that creates or matches its user.
  - A refused join creates no account and sends no invitation, and the refusal is reported on the row.
  - Having no current organization refuses the whole import with `400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION`.
  - A matched existing user joins too.

  Three cells go past the option text: the whole-import 501, the whole-import 400 on a dry run, and rolling back the upsert profile when its join is refused. All three apply the option's own words 「和单个新建同一规矩」 (same rule as a single create). They are declared in the FROM → TO table and in the changeset.
- **File surface:** 7 files, +552/−58.
  - The dogfood pin sits in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts`, outside the claim's plugin-auth test paths. It is the existing harness for this same join, and the body names it.
  - `ui/` is untouched: the import response gains no field.
- **Mechanism, read in the source:**
  - **Shared settlement.** `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin` is create-user's former inline block, moved without change; its codes and sentences are byte-identical. create-user now calls it, and the import calls the same function before `runImport`, so the dry run is settled too.
  - **`inRowUnit`.** It wraps both the `createUser` and the matched-user update, together with `joinCurrentOrganization`, in `join.seam.runAtomically`. A `CreationRefused` is rethrown as a row error carrying the vendor's code and status, and any other throw passes through unchanged.
  - **Commit order.** The temporary password and invitation bookkeeping run only after the unit returns. An upsert with an empty patch still joins.
  - **`account: 'existing'`.** On a refusal it drops the "no user was created" clause, and it reports an existing member as `membershipCreated: false`. create-user passes nothing, so its behaviour is unchanged.
  - **Wiring.** `auth-plugin.ts` reads the session the same way create-user does.
  - **Audit.** The run row carries `organizationId` only in multi-org mode.
- **Tests:**
  - 10 unit cases on a harness whose unit of work really restores the tables on throw, with a better-auth-coded member cap; a single-org CONTROL is among them.
  - Dogfood I1 and I2 on the real engine. I1 asserts that the refused row's account is gone from `sys_user`.
  - Ablations: "no join" leaves 8 of the 10 cases failing; "join outside the unit" leaves 4 failing. The FROM reading was taken through `dist`. Restore was proven.
  - No existing test was changed.
- **Gates at this head:**
  - Check-runs on `6bfc9758…`: 61 runs, all completed, 42 `success`, 19 `skipped`, 0 failed.
  - `git merge-tree --write-tree` against today's `origin/main` is clean.
  - `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34750`, read here: 0 of 7 paths governed, 610 lines.
  - The full dogfood battery is pinned at `870ce227` (4057 passed). The final head differs from it by one docs anchor only.

### Before landing (no head move)

- **Card surface amendment.** Please post a claim amendment on #34535 that names `packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts`. The body explains the placement, but the claim's surface was written as stop-on-breach.

### Owed outside this PR

- **ADR-0093 D3 amendment, `docs/adr/0093-tenancy-mode-and-membership-lifecycle.md` around line 273.** It still reads "…every other creation path (self sign-up, bulk import, SSO JIT, host hooks), still binds nothing in multi mode". That becomes false for bulk import when this PR lands.
  - The ruling names the implementing PR as the one that rewrites it. The claim routed the edit to the seat instead, because `docs/adr/**` is governed.
  - Either way, the seat owes that Tier H edit. It should land with this PR or immediately after it, so the record and the code do not disagree for long.

### Owed after this

- **L2: owed, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`** (a declared narrowing).
- **Landing tier: narrowing, handed to the seat for Tier H.** Not governed.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6bfc975899a1ed10282cfe967eb01ed3ad7e8ea8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .changeset/34535-import-users-current-organization.md, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts + packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/platform-admin-gate.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/reconcile-membership.ts, docs/adr/0093-tenancy-mode-and-membership-lifecycle.md, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs (read in the cited code, not reviewed). Prose face content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx was read against the code only.

Security-touching: yes
The diff changes who becomes a member of which organization. No access finding: the route stays behind the platform-admin gate (`gateAdmin`, `judgePlatformAdmin`), the organization is read from the caller's own session and never from the request body, and the role written is always `member`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **import-users accept-set, multi-org only: four answers narrowed** (no current organization 400 whole, dry run included; no unit of work or no `addMember` 501 whole; a refused row creates no account; an upsert-matched user whose join is refused keeps its old profile). Right, and each is declared in the changeset's BREAKING list and the PR's FROM and TO table. Read in `runAdminImportUsers`: the settlement runs after request validation and before `runImport`, so nothing is written on either whole-request refusal.
- **create-user answers unchanged.** Right. The block removed from `runAdminCreateUser` and the body of `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin` are the same text: same predicate, same order (400 before 501), same two codes and the same two sentences. `joinCurrentOrganization`'s new fifth parameter defaults to `'created'`, and on that arm the refusal sentence and `membershipCreated: true` are what `main` answers. create-user passes four arguments.
- **Single-org and a degraded wall unchanged.** Right. `multiOrgCreationJoinsCurrentOrganization` answers false before the session is read, `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin` answers `undefined`, and `inRowUnit` then calls the write directly with no transaction opened. The CONTROL case pins that the session reader, `addMember` and `runAtomically` are never called.
- **Public surface: additive only.** `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin`, `CurrentOrganizationJoin`, the optional `account` parameter, and two optional members on `IdentityImportDeps` (`getTenancy`, `getCallerActiveOrganizationId`). A host that calls `runAdminImportUsers` without the two new members keeps `main`'s behaviour, as create-user's predicate already reads. Right.
- **Response shape: no new field.** A refused row answers `action: 'failed'` with the vendor's code read by `mapAuthApiError` and carried through `toFailedResult` as the thrown `code`. New values in an existing field. Right.
- **Audit row: `organizationId` added to the `user.import_run` metadata in multi-org mode.** Additive. Right.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs: none`, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.** Right: no file under `packages/spec` is in the diff, no skill names the route, and no stored row, key or export changes shape.
- **Upsert rows always reach the join.** Right. In `import-runner.ts` a matched row always calls `updateData`, and the head no longer returns early on an empty patch, so a matched user joins even when no profile field changes. Blank-key rows are skipped before the write and join nothing, as before.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

`@objectstack/plugin-auth: patch` with a `!` subject and a **BREAKING** section. That is the level `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` asks for: a declared `Metadata-protocol: none` must grade every entry `patch`, and no `major` is introduced. The BREAKING section carries four FROM and TO pairs, one per narrowed answer, and a one-line fix for the caller (switch to the organization first; raise `OS_ORG_MEMBERSHIP_LIMIT` for a capped row). The changeset matches what the diff publishes; I found no narrowed answer in the code that the list omits.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Three cells beyond the ruling's text** (dev flag). Answered, none needs a new ruling before this lands:
  - *Dry run refused 400 with no current organization.* Inside the ruling's own words ("the whole import is refused"). A preview answering 200 for a file whose import answers 400 would misreport the import.
  - *501 whole when the join cannot run in the account's unit of work.* The ruling requires the join "in the same unit of work that creates the account". A host that cannot do that can only deliver member-less accounts, which the ruling forbids. Same rule and sentence as create-user. In the shipped wiring `createGrant` is always passed, so this is reached only when better-auth's organization plugin is off under a walled posture.
  - *Upsert profile update rolled back with a refused join.* This rests on the seat's reading in 6942842013 (matched existing users join too), which that comment marks as inside the maintainer's veto window, not on the option text. Given that reading, one unit per row is the consistent choice: the alternative is a row reported failed that still wrote. Defensible. For the approver, one consequence the card does not spell out: the upsert match runs deployment-wide under the system context, so a profile-refresh upsert now also adds every matched user, including users of other organizations, to the administrator's current organization as `member`. There is no longer a profile-only upsert in multi-org mode. The actor is a platform administrator who can perform Add Member anyway, so this is a product consequence, not an access finding; it should be visible at Tier H approval.
- **Test file outside the claim's paths** (dev flag). Accepted: the dogfood file is the existing real-engine harness for this join.
- **ADR-0093 D3's closing sentence becomes untrue for bulk import.** Ruling 6942842013 says the sentence "is rewritten by the implementing PR"; the claim moved it to the seat because `docs/adr/**` is outside an implementing card's surface, and the PR body points to #34809 (not among this review's inputs, not read). Shipping the code first is acceptable: the changeset, the product docs and the module header all state the new rule, and the ADR edit has its own approval path. It is a deviation from the ruling's letter, so #34809 should land in the same release window. The ADR text itself is not graded here.
- **Atomicity, tried five ways.**
  - Membership insert fails after the user insert: `CreationRefused` leaves `runAtomically`, the engine transaction rolls back, and the temporary password and the invitation target are recorded only after the unit returns. Pinned for `invite` and `temporary`, and on the real engine by I1.
  - Duplicate email in one file: on insert the second `createUser` throws inside its own unit and fails that row as on `main`; on upsert the second row matches the first, finds the membership, and adds nothing.
  - Existing user already in another organization: joined to the current one (see the upsert flag above).
  - Dry run with no current organization: 400, pinned.
  - Single-org: no transaction, no join, pinned.
  - Inherited limit, not introduced here: `createGrantFor(...).runAtomically` falls through to a plain call when the engine or the datasource has no transaction (the engine's declared limit, warned once per driver). On such a datasource a refused row would leave its account behind while the row says no user was created. create-user has the same limit today; the 501 cell checks that a seam is wired, not that it is transactional.
- **SQL push-down.** No new id materialisation and no in-app join. The join is one `sys_member` existence probe (`limit: 1`) and one `addMember` per row, inside the per-row unit the ruling requires so that the other rows go on.
- **Check-runs on this head.** Pending, so not verdicts: `Check Changeset` (run 44070143991) and `PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path)` (run 44070143814). Both have earlier completed runs on this same head that concluded success. Concluded success: Build Core, Test Core and its eight shards, TypeScript Type Check and the Type Check family, Lint and Repo Gates and the Lint family, Build Docs, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected by code changes, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Live E2E UI, and the `Dogfood Regression Gate` aggregate. No check concluded failure.
- **Dogfood evidence.** The three `Dogfood Regression Gate` shard jobs and `Dogfood Verify CLI` concluded **skipped** on this head; only the aggregate concluded success. The real-engine evidence for I1 and I2 is therefore the dev's local battery (4057 passed on `870ce227`), which this read-only review cannot confirm. Verified with git: `870ce227` to the head is one line in `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` (the anchor), and the commit before it is the one-line type cast in the unit test harness. The seat should confirm the dogfood shards run before merge.
- **Tests as pins.** Real pins of each cell: refused row (account gone, no invitation, no temporary password, other rows land), 400 for both import and dry run asserted equal to the settlement's own answer, 501 for both causes, upsert join and no double add, upsert rollback of the profile, and the single-org control. I1 and I2 pin the created-row rollback and the 400 on the real route.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

The narrowing makes an existing refusal real; it does not take a declared capability away at the consumer. On `main` a multi-org import produced accounts in no organization, which the D8 amendment of ADR-0093 leaves with no data access, and whose `positions` were refused on every row. Nothing published promised that outcome as a capability; the only text describing it is the D3 closing sentence, which the maintainer ruled rewritten. The new refusals are create-user's, reached through one shared settlement and one shared join, not a copy. I tried to break the design on ordering (validation before settlement, settlement before any write), on the retry wrapper around the row write (a retried unit starts from a rolled-back state), on the positions pass (a rolled-back row is not walked), and on the organization source (session only). None broke.

- N1 (nit) — the prose face keeps `main`'s sentence that upsert updates "only touch profile fields" a few bullets above the new bullet saying a matched user also joins the organization. Both are true of the user row, but a reader can take the first as "upsert changes nothing else". Fixable on the prose face, or left.
- N2 (nit) — I1 asserts the refused row's sentence and the missing `sys_user` row, not the row's `code` and not the credential row. The unit pin covers the code; the transaction covers the credential row. Left as an accepted gap or a follow-up.
- N3 (nit) — on the 400 and 501 whole-request refusals the sentence is create-user's singular ("no user was created", "the new user"). The ruling asks for the same code and sentence, so this is as ruled; noted only because an import reads it about a file.

- 为什么改：执行你对 #34535 的裁决 B「入当前组织，被拒行不建号」(6942842013)。以前多组织下导入的用户不属于任何组织,`positions` 列每行都被拒，托管版用一份 CSV 建带岗位的员工走不通。
- 风险与回滚：**收窄(BREAKING)**,四处答复变了：无当前组织整单 400(含 dryRun);服务器跑不了加入时整单 501;被拒行不再建号;upsert 匹配到的已有用户加入被拒时连资料更新一起回滚。单组织模式不变。回滚即撤回本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`(`inRowUnit`)、`admin-user-endpoints.ts`(抽出的 `settleCurrentOrganizationJoin`)、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/create-user-organization-join.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 5/5 绿。
- 需要你做的：用 os-zhuang 审读并批准(收窄，按 Tier H 交人)，**并请确认两点**:① 席位对裁决 B 的读法：多组织下 CSV 按邮箱 upsert 匹配到的、本属其他组织的已有用户，也会以 member 身份加入管理员当前组织;② 本 head 上 dogfood 三个分片被选择器跳过,5/5 与全量 4057 过是本地读数(870ce227,与本 head 只差一行文档锚点);合并队列跑全量，会补上这一读数。批准即视为你接受这两点。契约复审 PASS 6946273468,钉在 Head-sha `6bfc975899a1ed10282cfe967eb01ed3ad7e8ea8`。批准在案后由席位翻 ready,经合并队列落地。

席位意见：同意合并。按裁决 B 实现，超出裁决原文的三格(501、dryRun 无组织、upsert 回滚)都套用「和单个新建同一规矩」并已申报。

## 席位核对

1. 形态:7 个文件，+552/−58,`Fixes #34535`;`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`,`Metadata-protocol: none`,标题带 `!`。非受管 0/7;收窄 ⇒ 按 Tier H 交人。
2. 前提实测:main 上多组织导入的行不入任何组织，带 `positions` 的行被成员资格校验拒(卡上复现)。
3. 门禁 check-runs:head `6bfc9758` 上 65 条,44 绿、21 跳、0 红;区报门禁 108/108;dogfood 本地全量 4057 过(见上)。
